entities.summary: Mohammed Hussain was an Indian field hockey and soccer player who competed in the hockey tournament the 1936 Summer Olympics. He belonged to the Beary society, whose mother tongue was Beary Bashe. He was the captain for the hockey club Manavadar, which was then a British protectorate. Hussein worked for the Prince of Manavadar. and also represented India against South Africa in soccer in 1934.
